nom: Dr. Althea Green Relief Amino Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports less redness and acne after using this cleanser.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports no issues and describes the wash as gentle.

concerns.redness: One reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports noticeably less redness after switching to this cleanser.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notices improved pore clarity; another reports less acne on oily, breakout-prone skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily skin reports fewer breakouts and less acne; one with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports no new issues.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and gentle on the skin barrier, with one contrasting it favorably against CeraVe for cleansing power without dryness.

aspects.libelle: Does not strip or dry skin

extraits.texte: I have oily skin. Definitely prone to breaking out as well. Tried this cleanser for the first time and have noticed less redness and acne. I wish they had this in a bigger size.

This facial cleanser lathers so well without stripping away your natural barrier and your feels so clean. You only need a dime size. I would normaly use the CeraVe because of my husband i would use 2 pumps and I still wouldnt feel my face clean. Im glad i came across this one. Will definitely buy again.

Good basic cleanser! Not overly hydrating but not super stripping either. No scent. Just perfectly in the middle. A little goes a long way. Snagged it on sale at around $11 and it think thats the best price for this cleanser.

I absolutely love this facewash. Makes my my skin feel so clean and soft while brightening my skin tone! I have sensitive acne prone skin and havent had any issues with this face wash. Favorite ive used in years!
It foams up into a lovely lather and doesn't dry out my skin but definitely makes a big difference in my pore clarity!

reserve: Only 7 reviews are available and all but one are 5-star, so segment and concern coverage beyond oily and sensitive skin is thin.
